Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 10, 2026

Chanify is a notification tool. This policy explains how the Chanify app and our official service process your information. If you connect to a self-hosted server, that server's operator controls its data and retention practices; contact that operator for its policy.

Account and device information

To create or import an account and deliver notifications, the app sends your account identifier and public key, device identifier and public key, device name and model, device type, and Apple Push Notification service (APNs) token to the official service and servers you connect to. These identifiers are linked to your account and are used for authentication, device registration, and notification delivery.

Account private keys are kept in Apple's Keychain, and the account key can synchronize through iCloud Keychain according to your Apple settings. If you export or share an account QR code or backup, it contains sensitive account information. Only share it with devices and people you trust.

Messages and attachments

Messages and attachments are processed by the server to which you or your sender submit them. Notifications are delivered through Apple's APNs. The app stores received messages, channel settings, and downloaded files on your device and shares relevant data with its notification extensions, widgets, and your paired Apple Watch. A self-hosted server may store uploaded attachments; deleting your account does not necessarily remove files stored separately by that operator.

When you open or preview a link, image, audio clip, or file, the app may contact the corresponding website or file host. That host receives the network request and your IP address. The host's privacy policy applies to that request.

Access logs

The official service keeps access logs for up to 7 days for service operation and troubleshooting. These logs do not retain message content. Request metadata can include your IP address, request time, response status, and client user agent. The official service has no server-side backups. Self-hosted operators may have different logging and backup policies.

Permissions and your choices

Camera access is used to scan account, channel, or server QR codes. Photo library access is used to select a QR code image; permission to add photos is used to save a QR code you export. Local network access lets you connect to a self-hosted server on your network. Notification permission enables alerts. You can manage these permissions in the device's Settings app. Refusing a permission disables the related feature.

Chanify does not use advertising or track you across other companies' apps and websites. We use account and device information to provide the service, not for advertising. Apple processes APNs and iCloud Keychain data under its own privacy policy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/.

Retention and account deletion

Account and device registrations remain on the official service until deleted. To request permanent deletion, open Chanify's Settings and choose Delete Account. The app first requests deletion from your configured self-hosted nodes, then the official center service. Each server must be reachable and support account deletion. If deletion fails, the app keeps the account key so you can retry; an error does not mean deletion has completed.

After all servers confirm deletion, the app removes the account's local messages, settings, keys, and cached files from this device and requests cleanup on the paired Apple Watch. An offline Watch receives cleanup when it reconnects. Sign out of the account on your other devices. Copies already delivered to other devices, manually exported QR codes or backups, separately hosted attachments, and the official service's access logs are not erased by this action. Access logs expire within the 7-day period above. Logging out alone does not delete the server account.

You can revoke notification and other permissions in device Settings and contact support@chanify.net to ask about your information or request help with deletion. For data held by a self-hosted operator, contact that operator directly.

Security

Chanify uses Apple's security APIs for cryptographic operations and Keychain storage. Use HTTPS for servers whenever possible. Connections to an HTTP self-hosted server do not have TLS transport protection. No network or storage system can guarantee absolute security.

Children and policy changes

Chanify is not directed at children under 13. If you believe a child has provided personal information to the service, contact us so we can investigate and address it. We will publish changes to this policy on this page and update the date above.

Contact

For questions about this policy, access to your information, or deletion assistance, contact support@chanify.net.
